## Overview

**Think beyond the campaign. Shape marketing strategy.**

Marketing is about more than great ideas. It's about understanding audiences, making smart decisions and turning insight into impact.

De Montfort University's Marketing Management MSc helps you develop the strategic thinking and practical expertise to take your marketing career further. Whether you're building on an existing marketing background or moving into the field from another discipline, you'll learn to approach marketing challenges from a management perspective and a global outlook.
